description: As a ground handler, I want to view real-time baggage tracking status so that I can locate and route bags efficiently.

acs.text: Dashboard displays all bags for the selected flight with scan status.
Bags with no scan in 15 minutes are highlighted in red.
Clicking a bag row shows full scan history with timestamps.

sections.content: Backend: Node.js 18, Express. Uses the BRS (Baggage Reconciliation System) API v3. WebSocket connection for real-time updates. Frontend built with React 18 + TypeScript. Deployed on Azure App Service.
